reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Paired PBMC joint-sequencing and orthogonal RNA/protein fluorescence prevalence comparison.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer prior primary Methods or validated protocols before execution. Calibration alone is not this action.
Essential stimulation, sampling, staining and preparation settings are deferred; no quantitative source/calibration-to-setting procedure makes the primary workflow executable.
Correct independent biological units and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power or precision target connects meaningful effect and pilot variation to a confirmatory sample size.
Model families and contrasts are named but the primary likelihood/assumptions, diagnostics and multiplicity procedure remain unspecified.
Titration and sampling exploration lack a bounded quantitative search or derivation of bounds with a selection objective and setting lock.
Technical repair does not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after changes.
No complete immutable input manifest, exact software/environment/settings and command-to-output provenance chain is specified.
No clean-environment rerun with numerical figure outputs, declared tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit is planned.
RNA/protein positivity and discordance frequencies lack specified control-derived decision thresholds, weak/saturated signal handling and explicit retained denominators.
Blinding is proposed, but no randomized/balanced donor-condition processing order or lane allocation is supplied.
Two technical halt thresholds are supplied, but no assigned-sample attrition accounting or bounded replacement/confirmatory stopping policy is given.
Standard dimensionality reduction and discordance analysis are named without their transformation/observation principles and limitations.

checks.quote: proving the sequencing-based disagreement is assay-specific noise
checks.reason: Failure of an orthogonal assay to detect a state does not prove artifact without a calibrated target-specific detection/equivalence bound. A paired t-test for difference is also not proof of prevalence equivalence.
No biological-unit-separated discovery/tuning/test procedure with all feature/preprocessing fits contained in discovery is specified.
Technical-covariate correlation and control measurements do not supply a parameter/depth/missingness stress test that retains genuine biological variability.

checks.quote: preserving these states as distinct phenotypic clusters
checks.reason: Real RNA/protein discordance may be continuous and need not form a distinct cluster. Orthogonal prevalence alone does not mandate this representation or identify the best integration algorithm.

explanation_reason: Useful orthogonal comparison with some quantitative gates, but little executable/statistical detail and overstrong negative/cluster conclusions.
historical_match_reason: The biological value of complementary RNA/protein measurements is recognized, but the chosen direction is discordance kinetics and mechanism. It does not propose local cell-specific predictive modality weights, adaptive multimodal neighborhoods, a matched single/fixed/adaptive comparison or the corresponding held-out integration gain. A valid alternative biological study earns scientific credit, not the sealed integration-direction hit.
